title: Kids raised by relatives vs. kids in the official foster care system (thousands)

source.name: State of Grandfamilies / Kinship Care data (children raised by grandparents or other relatives), compared with the federal foster care count
source.publisher: Generations United (compiling U.S. Census Bureau / AECF KIDS COUNT data), and the Administration for Children and Families (AFCARS Report #30)

notes: Generations United reports about 2.6 million children live in households headed by grandparents, other relatives, or close family friends (kinship/grandfamilies), synthesizing Census Bureau and AECF KIDS COUNT data. For comparison, AFCARS Report #30 (Children's Bureau, Administration for Children and Families, HHS) counted 343,077 children in the official, licensed foster care system nationwide on September 30, 2023 (https://acf.gov/cb/report/afcars-report-30). These are different systems measured differently (informal kinship care vs. the licensed foster system) but both are the best available national counts of each.

points.label: In the official foster care system
